prompt: Prepare the `Changes` section for the change in evals/files/workspace-dependencies by comparing the base manifests under base/ with the current package manifests. The project uses the default description structure. Report affected package responsibilities and every added or removed runtime dependency edge, including any reverse edge, without inventing a dependency that the manifests do not contain.
expected_output: The section derives edges from the base-to-head manifest diff, names the app and core responsibilities, records the added app → core edge and the removed app → legacy edge, preserves the existing core → app reverse edge, and does not claim that the reverse edge is absent.
assertions: The section states the app and core package responsibilities.
The dependency edges are derived from the base-to-head manifest diff.
The added runtime edge is written as app → core.
The removed runtime edge is written as app → legacy.
The existing core → app runtime edge is reported rather than called absent.
The section does not hide the dependency cycle behind a composition-only explanation.
